'''Thomas Louis Daniel''' (born 1954) is an American [[biologist]], Joan and Richard Komen Endowed Chair of Biology at [[University of Washington]],<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.biology.washington.edu/index.html?navID=42&parecID=68 |title=Univ of Washington Biology Dept |accessdate=2010-05-06 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20100203184144/http://www.biology.washington.edu/index.html?navID=42&parecID=68 |archivedate=2010-02-03 }}</ref> and the CEO of the Washington Research Foundation.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://faculty.washington.edu/danielt/people.html |title=The Daniel Lab |website=faculty.washington.edu |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20021102041559/http://faculty.washington.edu/danielt/people.html |archive-date=2002-11-02}} </ref>  He was the interim director of the [[National Science Foundation]] Engineering Research [[Center for Sensorimotor Neural Engineering]].<ref name="CSNE Bio">{{cite web|title=Thomas Daniel|url=http://www.csne-erc.org/users/daniel|publisher=ERC/SNE|accessdate=11 August 2012|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130928085535/http://www.csne-erc.org/users/daniel|archivedate=28 September 2013}}</ref>  Since 2006, he has served on the Scientific Advisory Board for the [[Allen Institute for Brain Science]].<ref name="Allen Bio">{{cite web|title=Thomas L. Daniel, Ph.D.|url=http://www.alleninstitute.org/about_us/sab_pac/thomas_daniel.html|publisher=Allen Institute for Brain Science|accessdate=11 August 2012|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://archive.today/20130223143405/http://www.alleninstitute.org/about_us/sab_pac/thomas_daniel.html|archivedate=23 February 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Washington Research Foundation Names Tom Daniel as New CEO |url=https://www.wrfseattle.org/news/washington-research-foundation-names-tom-daniel-as-new-ceo/ |work=Washington Research Foundation}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Schubert |first1=Charlotte |title=Meet Tom Daniel, the new CEO of Washington Research Foundation |url=https://www.geekwire.com/2022/meet-tom-daniel-the-new-ceo-of-washington-research-foundation/ |work=GeekWire |date=15 September 2022}}</ref>

Thomas graduated from the [[University of Wisconsin]] with a BS and MS, and from [[Duke University]] with a PhD, where he studied with [[Steven Vogel]] and [[Stephen Wainwright]]. He was the Bantrell Postdoctoral Fellow in Engineering Sciences at [[California Institute of Technology]] where he studied with [[Ted Wu]] until 1984. He is a member of the Washington State Academy of Sciences and a Fellow of the American Association for Advancement of Science.<ref>{{cite news |title=AAAS names 11 UW researchers as fellows |url=https://www.washington.edu/news/2012/11/29/aaas-names-11-uw-researchers-as-fellows/ |work=UW News |language=en}}</ref>
